data.title: Hop and Subtract: Number Line Adventures
data.description: Learn how to use the number line to subtract by jumping backwards.

challenges.instruction: Let's take a big leap! Put your finger on the number 4, and hop back 4 spaces to the left.
challenges.hint: Count your hops carefully as you jump backwards one by one starting from 4.

challenges.instruction: Let's count backward! Start at 15 on the number line and hop left 4 spaces. Where do you land?
challenges.hint: Put your finger on 15 and hop backward one space at a time, counting down four times.

challenges.instruction: Find the number 20 on your number line, and hop backward 5 spaces to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Start your finger on 20 and count backward 5 individual hops to the left.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 14 and hop backward 4 spaces to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Count each hop carefully as you move left from 14: 1, 2, 3, 4!
